Key contacts, programs and services Service NSW is committed to supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities to have a safe and rewarding experience when transacting with government. We've put together a guide to help you access contacts, programs and services relevant to you.

Savings Finder The NSW Government is offering more than 70 rebates and vouchers to help you save on everyday costs and more. You can:use the Savings Finder online tool to get a personalised list of savingsmake a free appointment to get help applying for savings, orbrowse a list of rebates and savings.
Contact us We're here to help you Visit a Service NSW Centre, Mobile Service Centre or call us on 13 77 88. We welcome your feedback on how we can better support you.

faqs.q: What support is available for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people getting a driver licence?
faqs.a: Service NSW provides support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people to help them get a driver licence.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about getting a driver licence?
faqs.a: You can find general information about getting an NSW driver licence at the Driver licence guide.
